## Symptom

EVERY rebar invocation that writes (and reads that reach _store/push.py) under sustained multi-writer load logs 'WARNING rebar.llm.enrich_drain: enrich drain gate check took N ms (> 20 ms budget)' with N observed 339-3589ms on a 5247-ticket store — a permanent, warned-on-every-command steady state.

## Mechanism (proven during /rebar-debug of 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee — see its RCA comment)

maybe_drain runs on the store write path (src/rebar/_store/event_append.py:398, src/rebar/_store/push.py:594) and calls queue.pending_enrichment (src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py:414). The O(1) gate marker (task 4144-75d3) is cleared by EVERY queue append, so under sustained concurrent writes the fast path never engages and every command pays a full queue scan. The 20ms budget (llm/config.py, overlap_drain_gate_budget_ms) was calibrated for the marker fast path, not for the full-scan fallback at this store size; the warning itself is by-design observability ('budget is an observed target, not a cutoff', enrich_drain.py:379-385). POST-3d57 refinement (assessment comment): the task-4144 live-set fast path ENGAGES and still costs seconds, because the marker-scoped walk is O(backlog) — a standing ~1,050-entry backlog prices every probe at 2-8s regardless of marker churn.

## Decision (recorded 2026-08-22, operator ruling — supersedes 'Decision needed')

Option 1 of the assessment comment's decision menu: the per-write gate check becomes an EXISTENCE-ONLY O(1) probe (early-exit at the first pending hit), preserving the gate's yes/no decision semantics without enumerating the backlog. Rationale: cheapest fix that removes the per-write O(backlog) tax while staying marker-fast when quiet. Options 2 (LLM outside the lock / dedicated-clone drain) and 3 (backlog age-out policy) are explicitly OUT of this ticket's scope — option 2 is under separate design (relates_to 9c72).

## Acceptance criteria (re-scoped to the approved option-1 ruling)

- [x] A recorded decision on the gate contract, with rationale (the operator ruling above: existence-only probe; recorded as a ticket comment before implementation).
- [x] On the live 5,000+-ticket store under multi-session load with the standing ~1,050-entry backlog, the steady-state (marker-scoped) gate check meets its 20 ms budget (measured 1.0-1.5 ms, was 2,792-7,557 ms); overruns are bounded to post-queue-append cold probes (~40-120 ms, non-per-command), since the drain's own full walk rewrites the marker. Landed as Gerrit change 2140 / commit 59fad3133f9 with counted-not-timed scan-count and verdict-equivalence regression pins.
